mainEntity.name: What is the Apache 2.0 license, and why are all deliverables released under it?

It grants anyone who receives the licensed work an irrevocable, perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free copyright and patent license to reproduce, prepare derivative works of, publicly display, perform, sublicense, and distribute the work and derivative works in source, binary, or document form. All training materials, starter repositories, architectural patterns, runbooks, documentation, and deep dives authored by Thomas Cherickal are released under Apache 2.0 to eliminate legal ambiguity, abolish proprietary software lock-in, and provide complete sovereign technical ownership to clients and learners.
